item.title: Proteas Men Set for Historic T20i Pink Day Send-off
item.description: JOHANNESBURG: Cricket South Africa is set to deliver an unforgettable Pink Day when the Proteas Men host the West Indies in the final KFC T20 International (T20I) at a sold-out DP World Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg on Saturday, 31 January. The match will mark the first time the national side takes the field in a T20I wearing pink as they stand united in the fight to beat breast cancer. item.title: VENUE CHANGE OF PROTEAS WOMEN FIXTURE IN KIMBERLY DUE TO COMPLIANCE CONCERNS
item.description: Cricket South Africa (CSA) has taken the decision to move the upcoming third T20 International fixture between the Proteas Women and Pakistan Women that was scheduled to be held at the Kimberly Oval, following an independent assessment which confirmed that the facility does not meet the required international norms and standards for match readiness.
